messages.subject: Error in getGenomeInformation
parts:
Hello all,

Just started using aroma, and I'm afraid I'm not getting very far :( I
think I've got a handle on how the directory structure works and can
read in some information from the cdf file correctly, but
getGenomeInformation is giving an error.

What is quite strange is that a colleague is able to execute the
command correctly from the same directory, although they are running a
slightly older version of aroma.affymetrix.

messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: Error in getGenomeInformation
parts:
Hmm, looks alright to me.

Next troubleshooting is to see if the file is corrupt or can cannot be
read for some reason.

First, try:

path <- "annotationData/chipTypes/GenomeWideSNP_6/";
filename <- "GenomeWideSNP_6,Full,na24,HB20080214.ugp";
ugp <- AromaUgpFile(filename, path=path);
print(ugp); # Important to try this one
...
print(getFileSize(ugp));
[1] 9407568
print(getChecksum(ugp)); # Verify correctness of file
[1] "7b29405939b1bf2cb018956c4003de02"

If that works, then try:

ugp <- AromaUgpFile$byChipType("GenomeWideSNP_6,Full", tags="na24,HB20080214");
print(ugp);

then:

ugp <- AromaUgpFile$byChipType("GenomeWideSNP_6,Full", tags="na24");
print(ugp);

then:

ugp <- AromaUgpFile$byChipType("GenomeWideSNP_6,Full");
print(ugp);

If these don't work, add verbose=-100 to the call and see what is reported.

If the above works, we know that the file is working and can be found
by regular means. Then, try to do:

cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType("GenomeWideSNP_6", tags="Full");
gi <- getGenomeInformation(cdf, verbose=-100);

You should see something like:

Locating a GenomeInformation file...
Searching for type 'ugp'...
Instantiating UgpGenomeInformation...
Pathname: annotationData/chipTypes/GenomeWideSNP_6/GenomeWideSNP_6,Full,na24,HB20080214.ugp

list()

Name: GenomeWideSNP_6

File size: 8.97MB

RAM: 0.00MB
Chip type: GenomeWideSNP_6,Full

Instantiating UgpGenomeInformation...done
Searching for type 'ugp'...done
Locating a GenomeInformation file...done

Does any of this help you track down what is going on?

/Henrik
